title: Lyme Disease Case Maps | Lyme Disease | CDC
content: Lyme Disease Case Maps June 4, 2025 Key points These maps show reported Lyme disease cases for three timepoints: 2023, 2010, and 1995. Since 1995, the range of Lyme disease cases in the United States has expanded significantly. Cases are reported from the infected person’s county of residence (where known), not necessarily the place where the person was infected. Reported cases of Lyme disease, 2023 View Larger Download Map of the United States showing reported cases of Lyme disease in 2023. One dot placed in county of residence for each reported case.
